summary.en: A bass riff that echoes the kick, with an acidic colour.

verifiedAgainst.title: SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Creating bass and other sounds (SOUND GENERATOR)
SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Creating a new pattern (TR-REC)

text.ru: Бас в breakbeat — риф: 2–4 ноты, которые повторяют рисунок бочки.
text.en: The breakbeat bass is a riff: two to four notes that echo the kick pattern.

text.ru: [SHIFT] + [RECORD SETTING] — SOUND GENERATOR. [CTRL 1] — Type (Sine…), [CTRL 2] — Freq, [CTRL 3] — Level; [REC] и пэд сохраняют звук.
text.en: [SHIFT] + [RECORD SETTING] — SOUND GENERATOR. [CTRL 1] is Type (Sine…), [CTRL 2] Freq, [CTRL 3] Level; [REC] and a pad save the sound.

text.ru: Удерживая [SUB PAD], выбери бас и нажми пэды шагов 1, 3, 11: пэд = шаг.
text.en: Holding [SUB PAD], pick the bass and press the step pads 1, 3, 11: pad = step.

text.ru: Разный питч на шагах: [CTRL 2] (PITCH −12…+12) при вводе.
text.en: Different pitch per step: [CTRL 2] (PITCH −12…+12) while entering.

tryIt.en: Give step 3 a pitch of +3 and step 11 a pitch of −2.
